sourceRefs.locator: Latin American Antiquity 28(1), pp. 127–143. For the 1519 foundation and its date see pp. 128–130. Figure 2, figure 3 and tables 1–2, pp. 129–134, locate the five grinding tools, stratigraphic contexts and thirteen grains identified as maize. Discussion of wild food and shellfish on pp. 137–139.
Sections 1.1–1.2 and figure 3. Coastal habitats, shellfish, sixth-century human remains, the Indigenous settlement at Morelos Park and instructions for Spanish port foundations.

Geographical data, component 1582rev-005, Archaeological Site of Panamá Viejo, 9°00′23.97″ N, 79°29′06.98″ W. General point for the site. Aceituno and Martín figure 2 locates the excavated square and neighbouring properties within it.

labels.de: Panamá entsteht auf einem älteren Siedlungsplatz
labels.en: Panamá is founded on an older settlement

note.de: Am späteren Hauptplatz sind indigene und koloniale Schichten erhalten. Mahlsteine aus den frühen Stadthäusern tragen Spuren von Mais.
note.en: Indigenous and colonial deposits survive at the later main square. Grinding tools from early colonial properties carry traces of maize.
